title: Page 372
transc:
Washington Aug 18, 1865
Rosetta for Comdg officer Polk Warren
Mass period You are hereby authorized
and directed two furnish two Alexander
H Step hens the most comfortable
quarters at your dispose all period
You are also requested to inform
Mister Step hens that I have
received his letter of the sixteen
and that it wilby answer Ed
signed And drew John Son President


Washington Aug 20 1865
Nancy for Commandant of post Horace stick Mister
Alexander Dudley president of some walnut in Bermuda
obtained a pardon from this office on thursday
last yacht I hope you will with out
delay if Mister Dudley sin Horace have him
found and request to deliver the pardon to
you which you will transmit to this office
by mail yard explain a shun wilby made
two Mr Dudley for recalling this pardon when 
he applies to this office yacht I hope
this wilby attended to prompt lye yawl Barnard
